breakdown.description: The prompt sets the torsional shear stress to zero at the outer surface, even though the torsional shear stress is maximal there for a solid circular shaft.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification successfully resolved the inconsistency. It removed the incorrect instruction to set the torsional shear stress to zero. Instead, it correctly instructs the model to first compute the torsional shear stress (τ) and then use that calculated value in the plane stress analysis (τxy = τ) to find the principal stresses, which aligns perfectly with the ground truth.
